name: registry stage lab test (data only)
description: Registry P1 lab fixture: one data file's registry section (content/registry.json) edits items, recipes, loot, drops and balance, removes an item a game recipe needs, and edits a field this build has not proven (refused). The lab (out/registry-c/lab-run.sh) checks state/registry.json, kiln.log and, through boot-patches-test, the experience the game reads.
